test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question: Four figure pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?
solution:
The logic followed in the options is:

**Symbol inside square 1st figure is getting thrice in 2ⁿd figure.**

Option1) Symbol inside square in 1st figure is getting thrice in 2nd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f2fbc8dd8479e3c8153ffba8d8cfc53e2e5d248ec47b6379956a35bbf98f7ee.png] 

Similar logic follows for Option (2) and Option (4)

**But, in Option (3)**

Symbol inside square in 1st figure is **not **getting thrice in 2nd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27d5aaa25f89c6b24ee3a1608aee961311866976cfe1ee0eb279acfd8a1bcb81.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
